procedure: Each *.json fixture was canonicalized by the npm `canonicalize` package's own CLI (bin/canonicalize.js, RFC 8785 JCS reference implementation co-authored by RFC 8785 author Anders Rundgren): `node canonicalize/bin/canonicalize.js < <fixture>.json > <fixture>.canonical.bytes`, installed with `npm i --no-save canonicalize` into a scratch directory outside this repository (never committed). The resulting bytes are compared byte-for-byte against underwrite_core.canonical.canonical_bytes(json.load(fixture)) in packages/underwrite-core/tests/test_canonical.py.
